title: SYNTHETIC: Remote service creation from a workstation
description: SYNTHETIC. The SIEM correlated a network logon by svc-backup on server FS-02 from workstation WS-ENG-007 (198.51.100.23) followed within a minute by creation of a new service named UpdSvc that runs C:\Windows\Temp\psexesvc.exe. The same account logged on to two other servers in the previous hour. The bundle does not include the process tree on FS-02 or authentication logs from the domain controllers.

attributes.note: SYNTHETIC test data created for CADE development. Not a real incident.
